court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Mumbai at Bandra (Petition No.A-75/12 and Petition No.D-22/12)
case_name: Shri. Rajendra Mahadeo Deokule vs Smt. Suvarna Mahadeo Deokule

parties.respondent_defendant: Suvarna Rajendra Deokule & Anr. (wife and another)

facts_of_case: The wife filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The husband also filed a petition for custody of the children. Both petitions were disposed of by a common Judgment and Order dated 16th July, 2016. The impugned order allowed the wife's petition for divorce and granted maintenance to their unmarried daughter.

legal_principles.principle: When both parents are earning, they are liable to contribute equally as proportionate to their income.
legal_principles.held: As stated above, petitioner's income is on higher side than the respondent. Petitioner has prayed for awarding Rs.15,000/- per month each for the children.

legal_principles.principle: The amount of maintenance should be just and reasonable considering all expenses.
legal_principles.held: Thus, considering all these expenses, the petitioner's claim of Rs.15,000/- per month each for children appears to be just and reasonable.

outcome.final_order: The Applicant (original Appellant) sought a stay of the impugned order insofar as it relates to payment of maintenance of Rs.10,000/- per month to the unmarried daughter and refund of Rs.50,000/- wrongly paid by the Applicant.

use_for_drafting: seeking stay of family court order
